content_blocks.title: A small PHP example for Type Aliases, mixed, never, and void
content_blocks.code:
<?php
readonly class Point { public function __construct(public int $x, public int $y) {} }
$p = new Point(3, 4);
echo $p->x + $p->y . PHP_EOL;
